research_updates.title: City accounts connect DET01's incentive period to continuing taxable property and paid charges
research_updates.notes: Southfield identifies EdgeConneX on the 3.5-acre real parcel, classifies the 40,148-square-foot structure as a computer center remodeled in 2014, and preserves the 2014 Cybernetix-to-EdgeConneX sale. The tax ledger supplies separate real-parcel, IFT and post-expiration commercial-personal account histories. The amended state certificate ran through December 30, 2019; the former-IFT personal account begins showing nonzero tax in 2020. Values, account charges and paid totals remain distinct, recipient allocations are unavailable, and the city job and wage plan remains a forecast rather than a realized employment claim.

research_updates.title: Operator reports and dimensions search
research_updates.notes: Source family: EdgeConneX operator reports. Exact queries: DET01, Detroit Data Sheet, 21005 Lahser; inspected the July 28, 2014 launch release and 2024 and March 2026 data sheets. Useful result: existing DET01 is reported at 39,900 square feet and 3 MW N+1, with 9,930 square feet raised floor in 2026; the potential 7 MW second building is excluded. Negative result: no facility meter, PUE, WUE, construction cost, payroll, supplier-payment or community-funding series.

source.title: Detroit DET01 data sheet
source.notes: The current operator sheet identifies DET01 at 21005 Lahser Road, Building 4, reports a 39,900-square-foot facility and 3 MW of N+1 power, and separately describes a potential second 7 MW building. Only the existing DET01 specifications are transcribed; the potential second building is not treated as operating capacity. The sheet describes N+1 CRAC cooling but provides no metered electricity, PUE, WUE, water, wastewater, generator runtime or emissions value.

research_updates.title: Identity and chronology search
research_updates.notes: Source families: operator releases, City parcel/permit records and City ACFRs; exact identifiers 21005 Lahser Road, parcel 76-24-33-476-055, PB14-0532, JALC14-0126, EdgeConneX and Cybernetix; inspected 2011-2026 history. Useful result: July 28, 2014 sale, June 26, 2014 permit application, August 15 issuance, January 21, 2015 final and operation no later than March 11, 2015. Negative result: no exact construction start or commissioning certificate; the 2021-2022 ACFR's 21107 Lahser reference is not assigned to the selected parcel.

source.title: EdgeConneX and TelNet Worldwide Partner to Launch Michigan's Newest State-of-the-Art Data Center
source.notes: The release identifies the Southfield Tier III project and says it was poised for a November 2014 launch. This is a forward-looking launch statement rather than a commissioning certificate, construction start, worker count, supplier-spending amount or realized employment observation.

research_updates.title: Capital, construction and procurement search
research_updates.notes: Source family: Southfield Building Department; exact address and records PB14-0532, JALC14-0126 and PB22-0524; inspected all 38 address-matched permits from available history through 2026. Useful result: interior alteration, backup-generator installation and later data-hall/UPS equipment infill, with Burr Computer Environments Inc. named as contractor. Negative result: no contract value, final construction cost, worker count, payroll, local-purchase share or subcontractor payments; displayed permit fees are not treated as capital spend.

source.title: City of Southfield BS&A building permit PB14-0532
source.notes: Permit PB14-0532 records EdgeConneX interior alterations and exterior backup generators: applied June 26, 2014, issued August 15, 2014, finaled January 21, 2015, contractor Burr Computer Environments Inc. The 38-record address list and later PB22-0524 equipment infill were also inspected. Displayed charges are permit fees, not construction cost; no contract value, worker count, payroll or local-supplier payment is shown.

research_updates.title: Employment and agenda-record search
research_updates.notes: Source family: City ACFRs, agendas, minutes and development materials; exact site searches EdgeConneX, Cybernetix, 21005 Lahser and JALC14-0126; inspected the 2012-2013 ACFR page 16 and 2021-2022 ACFR plus indexed City results. Useful result: source forecasts of 27 Cybernetix FTE at $67,000 and 10-15 additional customer positions. Negative result: no payroll, realized headcount, local-residency, hiring-compliance, development agreement or minutes establishing fulfilled jobs.

source.title: City of Southfield 2012-2013 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
source.notes: PDF page 16 / printed page 9 describes Cybernetix's planned conversion of the vacant 40,148-square-foot shell at 21005 Lahser Road into a Tier III wholesale data center, with 27 projected full-time employees by 2015 at a projected $67,000 average annual salary. The later state certificate and city account history connect the site to EdgeConneX, but do not verify the job or wage plan.

research_updates.title: Tax-certificate and incentive search
research_updates.notes: Source families: Michigan Treasury/State Tax Commission and MEDC transparency; exact queries 2013-088, 2013-088A, EdgeConneX, Cybernetix, 21005 Lahser and final costs; inspected the original and December 16, 2015 amended certificates and state award results. Useful result: transferred six-year IFT components with approved projections of $16,251,600 real and $18,935,500 personal property through December 30, 2019. Negative result: no final-cost filing, counterfactual tax-expenditure value, MEDC award, disbursement or compliance report.

source.title: Michigan State Tax Commission - amended Industrial Facilities Exemption Certificate 2013-088A
source.notes: Pages 32-33 identify EdgeConneX Detroit Holdings LLC at 21005 Lahser Road, transfer part of Cybernetix LLC's real and personal property into amended certificate 2013-088A, list approved investment by component and define the six-year real- and personal-property certificate period through December 30, 2019. The approved amounts remain projections because a final-cost filing was not located.

research_updates.title: Energy utility and regulator search
research_updates.notes: Source families: Michigan Public Service Commission cases and DTE official materials; exact queries EdgeConneX, EdgeConneX Detroit Holdings, EDCDET01 and 21005 Lahser; inspected available case/search results through September 6, 2026. Negative result: no facility tariff, service agreement, interval data, annual bill, load, capacity allocation, utility investment or system-cost record. The operator's 3 MW rating is therefore not converted into electricity use, PUE, emissions or utility impact.

source.title: Michigan Public Service Commission case and hearing information
source.notes: MPSC case materials and DTE's official domain were searched for EdgeConneX, EdgeConneX Detroit Holdings and 21005 Lahser. No facility-specific tariff, service agreement, bill, load, capacity allocation or utility system-cost record was located.

research_updates.title: Water and wastewater search
research_updates.notes: Source families: Southfield BS&A utility account, City rate notices and 2024 service-line inventory; exact records parcel 76-24-33-476-055, account 019890-001, WATER/WATER2 and inventory row 17040; inspected 1,176 history items spanning 2005-2026. Useful result: WATER2 rose 46 billing units from December 26, 2024 to December 23, 2025, and the City defines a unit as 100 cubic feet. Negative result: no audited calendar-year consumption, wastewater discharge, reuse, capacity charge or marginal infrastructure cost.

source.title: City of Southfield BS&A utility-billing history for parcel 76-24-33-476-055
source.notes: Utility account 019890-001 identifies EdgeConneX and displays 1,176 history items across WATER and WATER2. WATER2 moves from 662 on December 26, 2024 to 708 on December 23, 2025, a 46-unit change over 362 days. The portal does not label the series as consumption or discharge and does not audit account completeness.

research_updates.title: Federal facility and environmental dataset search
research_updates.notes: Source families: EPA ENERGY STAR and ECHO, OSHA establishment search and SAM.gov; exact queries EDCDET01, EdgeConneX and 21005 Lahser Road; inspected public results through 2026. Useful result: ENERGY STAR lists EDCDET01 at 40,766 square feet with 2024-2026 certifications. Negative result: no public certification energy quantity or score, address-matched ECHO result, DET01 OSHA establishment record or federal award.

source.title: EPA ENERGY STAR certified data centers listing for EDCDET01
source.notes: The federal listing identifies Michigan facility EDCDET01, owner EdgeConneX Inc., 40,766 square feet, construction year 2002 and certifications in 2024, 2025 and 2026. The public listing does not disclose facility electricity, score, PUE, water, emissions or savings, so certification is not converted into an operating-impact amount.

research_updates.title: Community-giving and operator sustainability search
research_updates.notes: Source family: EdgeConneX 2024 sustainability report and community-engagement page; exact in-document queries Detroit, DET01, Southfield and Lahser; inspected current operator materials. Negative result: no DET01 donation, grantee, in-kind amount, volunteer valuation, electricity, PUE, WUE, water or emissions observation. Company-wide programs are not allocated to this site.

source.title: EdgeConneX sustainability report 2024
source.notes: The report and operator community-engagement material were searched for Detroit, DET01, Southfield and Lahser. They provide company-level programs but no DET01 electricity, PUE, WUE, water, emissions, donation amount, recipient or local procurement observation.

research_updates.title: Court, bond and financing search
research_updates.notes: Source families: Oakland Court Explorer and land records, SEC EDGAR and EMMA; exact queries EdgeConneX Detroit Holdings, 21005 Lahser, parcel 76-24-33-476-055 and Detroit within EdgeConneX financing exhibits; inspected available 1964-2026 land/court history, 2022-2024 ABS-15G filings and municipal-security results. Negative result: no DET01 litigation award, mortgage/project debt allocation, bond issue or site-level financed amount.

source.title: Oakland County property, land and court portal search for DET01
source.notes: Oakland Property Gateway, Clerk/Register property records and Court Explorer were searched for parcel 76-24-33-476-055, 21005 Lahser and EdgeConneX Detroit Holdings across available history. The City parcel already supplies the 2014 sale and liber/page; no additional project-specific monetary record was obtained. SEC EDGAR and EMMA searches found no DET01-address allocation or municipal bond record.

research_updates.title: Fiscal and public-service search
research_updates.notes: Source families: Southfield real, IFT and former-IFT account histories and City financial reports; exact accounts 76-24-33-476-055, 76-IP-13-000-088 and 76-99-43-004-025; inspected complete annual rows through tax year 2025. Useful result: verified account-level paid totals support a same-year 2025 aggregation. Negative result: no recipient allocation, marginal police/fire/road/water cost, infrastructure reimbursement or government-statement reconciliation, so only an explicit break-even threshold is retained and no net fiscal result is claimed.

source.title: City of Southfield 2021-2022 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
source.notes: The report and indexed City financial materials were searched for EdgeConneX, Cybernetix, 21005 Lahser and public-service or infrastructure costs. A separate 21107 Lahser EdgeConneX reference is not assigned to DET01. No marginal service-cost allocation or project-specific reimbursement was located.

research_updates.title: County economic-input and causal-design audit
research_updates.notes: Source family: repository-governed official BEA/BLS county panel; exact geography Oakland County FIPS 26125 and comparison pool, 2001-2024 employment, earnings and unemployment inputs; inspected pre/post series and prior mechanical matching outputs. Useful result: county context remains available. Negative result: no registered causal design, exact treatment isolation, exposure-screened controls, contamination audit, placebo tests or robust post-period identification; all three descriptive comparison estimates were removed rather than labeled as DET01 effects.

source.title: County Economic Core Panel source and design audit
source.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
source.notes: Repository panel inputs derive from official annual county real GDP, employment and average-weekly-wage series for 2001-2024. The corrective audit found no design evidence sufficient to interpret prior matched comparisons as DET01 effects.

project_description: EdgeConneX DET01 is a 39,900-square-foot colocation data center in Southfield, Michigan, created by remodeling a vacant commercial shell in 2014 and documented as operating by March 11, 2015.
